source: references/chat-source-register.json; exact PDF anchors retained privately

expectations.unfamiliar_citizen: Abstention or a lower anchor only if full meaning is supported; supplied explanation is not prior knowledge. No fixed level.
expectations.detailed_multitopic: Consider full citizen anchors for reasoned safeguards/evaluation. No invented actual influence or sustained involvement; compare Level 5/6 meanings and Level 7 boundary against pp.13–14 short or pp.18–19 extended. Abstain if unresolved.
expectations.denied_opportunities: No automatic low score due to unavailable opportunity. Record capability separately from actual influence and retain locality correction.
expectations.organisation_pilot: Consider Validation versus Integration using organisation p.16 and example boundary p.17; tested pilot arrangements are not embedded routine capability. No assessment outside own remit.
expectations.technical_lab: Consider experimental proof versus controlled validation of the specified component; representative/operational/qualification claims are unsupported. Apply exact technical pp.17–18 scale, not full-system maturity.
expectations.result_disagreement: Initial result remains historical; preferred level and hypothetical additional facts are separate, pending review. No automatic upgrade.
expectations.optional_comparison: Preference and reason are not readiness evidence; substantive answer is retained separately. No training eligibility.
